get_predict_unit: get a pretrained MLIP prediction unit for a specified model name with default or turbo inference settings
get_reference_energies: get atomic or bulk phase element reference energies for a pretrained model from HuggingFace Hub
pretrained_checkpoint_path_from_name: download and return the local checkpoint path for a pretrained model by name from HuggingFace Hub
HuggingFaceCheckpoint: create a HuggingFaceCheckpoint dataclass to define a model checkpoint filename, repo, subfolder, and reference energy files
available_models: list all available pretrained model names registered in the pretrained models configuration file
